topic: The court that read the consent string — IAB Europe's TC String ruled personal data (Brussels Market Court, May 2025)

drafts.text: Audit: Brussels Market Court, 14 May 2025 — IAB Europe's TC String ruled personal data; the court re-imposed the €250k fine itself. Joint controller confirmed for the consent-signal layer only, not the ad-bidding pipeline. Odds are cleaner: https://data-snack.com/snack/cookie-roulette #TCF #GDPR
